subject: Commitment thermometer: GPU pool allocations & lead-time alignment
messages:
From: Jacob Miller <jacob@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP ask — timeline for Dedicated & private deployment GPU lead times

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency numbers and the idea of a hybrid approach (hosted + dedicated H100 tranche for high-throughput inference). Before we move to procurement, procurement asked for a Mutual Action Plan that includes:
- Expected lead times for Dedicated capacity (H100) and Private on-prem options
- Minimum pool sizing recommendations for a 200QPS p50 target during business hours
- Acceptance milestones and rollback/contingency windows

Can you draft a MAP with these items this week? We’re targeting a signed commitment by end of May to hit a September go-live. If you need a procurement contact, cc’d the team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jacob
Head of ML Infrastructure, Sentinel Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Miller <jacob@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask — timeline for Dedicated & private deployment GPU lead times

Jacob, thanks — happy to take point. High level notes up front:
- Lead times: Dedicated (hosted Redwood Dedicated H100 tranche) typically 8–12 weeks from PO to reserved capacity for the first tranche; additional tranches 4–6 weeks. Private (VPC + on-prem) has more variability — 12–20 weeks depending on rack-level procurement and data center scheduling.
- Pool sizing: for 200QPS p50 (mixed short + medium responses), we recommend a baseline pool of 8 H100s with an operational buffer of 2 (10 total) to cover peak bursts and autoscale headroom.
- Acceptance milestones: evaluation (2-week eval cluster), canary (1-week production traffic ramp), SLA verification (30 days), final acceptance signoff.

I’ll attach a draft MAP and a tranche estimate for H100 delivery windows — can the procurement team review specific PO/T&C constraints? Alicia from our supply partner is on cc for questions on hardware lead times.

Next steps: I’ll send the MAP v1 workbook by EOD with explicit gating items and a suggested DocuSign term sheet for the commitment cadence.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jacob Miller <jacob@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@dbcloudsupplies.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask — timeline for Dedicated & private deployment GPU lead times

Priyom, thanks for the quick summary. A couple of clarifying asks from procurement & platform: 
1) The 8 H100 baseline — can you break that down into expected token throughput and per-model latency assumptions? We have a mix of two models (2.7b and 70b) and will likely route 60% of traffic to the smaller model.
2) For Private/on-prem: our datacenter has a 10–12 week window for rack space provisioning. If on-prem could be synchronized we’d prefer to align lead times to avoid a staggered rollout.
3) Requesting a contingency clause: if hardware lead times slip > 4 weeks, can Redwood provide interim burst capacity on hosted to meet SLA?

Procurement also asked to see a redlined term-sheet ahead of any DocuSign so they can surface legal CSRs. I’ll have our procurement rep upload comments to the HubSpot deal later today.

Can you and Karthik call out the per-model sizing assumptions in the MAP v1? That will make the acceptance criteria deterministic.

Thanks — Jacob

On Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 11:02 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (previous message)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jacob Miller <jacob@sentinelhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@dbcloudsupplies.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask — timeline for Dedicated & private deployment GPU lead times

Jacob / Procurement,

Attached is MAP_v1 (sentinel_map_v1.xlsx) which includes:
- Per-model sizing assumptions (sheet: Sizing) — we modeled the 2.7b @ ~3.2k tokens/s per H100 and the 70b @ ~450 tokens/s per H100 under your latency targets, factoring continuous batching and mixed request distribution. The 8 H100 baseline maps to ~230QPS effective (with 60/40 small/large split) at p50 latency target.
- Tranche schedule (sheet: TrancheTimeline) — first tranche (4 H100) ~10 weeks; second tranche (4 H100) ~6 weeks after first tranche delivery. On-prem sync path included: if Sentinel can commit rack reservation within 2 weeks of PO, we can align second-tranche delivery to reduce stagger to ~2 weeks.
- Acceptance & rollback (sheet: Acceptance) — eval cluster (14 days), canary ramp (0–20% traffic over 7 days), SLA verification (30 days), rollback window details and fallback to hosted burst.
- Contingency: We commit to temporary hosted burst capacity for up to 8 weeks if hardware delivery slips > 4 weeks (subject to usage credits and a short-term addendum).

Attachments included: h100-tranche-estimate.pdf (hardware ETAs) and a draft DocuSign-term-sheet.pdf with redlineable placeholders. I’ve also added a deterministic gating checklist so procurement can validate PO language quickly.

Questions for procurement/legal: please upload any redlines to the HubSpot deal or reply-all with an annotated DocuSign. Alicia — can you confirm the 10–12 week rack provisioning window is workable if Sentinel accelerates the rack reservation?

If this looks good I’ll convert MAP_v1 to a mutual-action project in HubSpot and propose weekly 30-minute checkpoints starting next Tuesday (4/20) to drive to commit.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: sentinel_map_v1.xlsx (workbook), h100-tranche-estimate.pdf (shipment ETA overview), DocuSign-term-sheet.pdf (draft)
